newsitem.title: USA: CSW, Phillips start building plant.
newsitem.headline: CSW, Phillips start building plant.

text.p: CSW Energy and Phillips Petroleum Co have started construction on a 325-megawatt cogeneration facility near Phillips' Old Ocean site in Sweeny, Texas, the companies said in a statement Thursday.
Phillips operates a large refinery and chemical plant at the site. The power plant would supply steam and low-cost electricity to the complex.
The power plant represents a $200 million investment, the companies said.
It would be fueled by residue gas and supplemented by natural gas in combustion turbines using dry, low NOx combustion technologies.
"This project represents a textbook case for the benefits of cogeneration," CSW Energy President and Chief Executive Terry Dennis said.
"By harnessing a resource which is not commercially marketable, CSW Energy is able to provide a highly efficient source of steam and low-cost electric power," he said.
